# Software Package Data Exchange (SPDX)

> SPDX is a standardized format for communicating software package information, licenses, and compliance data across the software supply chain.

Maintained by the Linux Foundation, SPDX provides a comprehensive license list with standardized identifiers and expressions, enabling organizations to track and manage open-source software licensing and compliance requirements efficiently.

## Key Topics

- Software Package Data Exchange (SPDX)
- SPDX Specification
- License Expression
- License Identifiers
- Open Source Licenses
- License Compliance
- Free Software
- Linux Foundation
- OSI
- FSF
- License List
- Reference Database
- Software Supply Chain
- Compliance Management

## License Reference

- [SPDX License List](https://spdx.org/licenses): Comprehensive reference database of open-source license identifiers and expressions for software compliance and supply chain management.
